messages.subject: Sign off: EMO-247 Creatordex: Dedicated creator gender and pronoun classification pipeline
messages.body:
**Launch Feature:** Serves **1. Search** (and Section 2: Creator profiles)
1. Problem: Creatordex lacks a deterministic pipeline to classify creator gender/pronouns from bio/profile text.
2. Importance: Avoids offensive misclassification and ungrounded guesses while honoring explicit creator self-identification.
3. Feel: Clear self-reported gender/pronoun badge on profiles and deterministic hard filtering in Search V4.
4. Deliverables: Gender classifier module, backfill script, Search V4 planner/retrieval filters, and Vitest suite.
5. Completed: 100% test pass on golden bio fixtures; hard search filters strictly match self-reported pronouns.
6. Validation: Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/gender-classifier.test.ts tests/unit/clean-search-gender.test.ts`.
7. Limits: Pre-merge testable via synthetic bios; full production backfill gated on database migration.
Spec vs PR: `matches` — [#1359](https://github.com/creatordex-main/creatorscout/pull/1359) (`FAIL-awaiting-worker` remediation).
Corrupted Sub-Issues: None under EMO-247.

:::question
Sign-off decision for EMO-247:

- [ ] APPROVE spec as written
- [ ] REPAIR — I will say what in a reply
- [ ] REJECT ticket
:::

choices.label: REPAIR
